many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
# vertical-flip about object bottom edge variant (never tried): out = obj + obj[:-1][::-1]
for p in [1,2]:
    a=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; b=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    H=len(a); W=len(a[0])
    S=min(i for i,r in enumerate(a) if any(x==6 for x in r))
    cand=a[:S]+a[S-1::-1][:H-S-1]  # object + flipped copy filling to bottom
    print(p,'cand == out:', cand==b)
ti=G['Test input']
S=max(i for i,r in enumerate(ti) if any(x==4 for x in r))+1
out=ti[:S]+ti[S-1::-1][:11-S]
print(json.dumps(out))

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    S=max(i for i,r in enumerate(g) if any(x==6 for x in r))
    obj=g[:S]                 # rows strictly above last 6-row; check height
    cand=obj[::-1]
    out=[]
    for r,row in enumerate(g):
        out.append(row[:])
    # clear marker
    for r,c in [(r,c) for r in range(S+1) for c,x in enumerate(g[r]) if x==6]:
        out[r][c]=0
    # paste flipped copy immediately below the object (starting at S - len(obj))
    start=S-len(obj)
    for i,row in enumerate(cand):
        out[start+i][0:W]=row[:]
    return out
for p in [1,2,3]:
    r=f(G[f'Demo pair {p} input']); e=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    print(p,'match:',r==e)
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))
